current.text: Aldama moved from Memphis to Dallas.
He had knee surgery at the end of last season and is not fully cleared. He will only take part in camp partly. His Yahoo status is questionable (undisclosed).
The Dallas frontcourt is crowded with forwards and bigs, so many players compete for his minutes.
His strong finish last season came from about 28 minutes a night on a Memphis team that was tanking.
Experts expect him to be the seventh man, with minutes in the low 20s. They do not expect the 28 minutes of last season to repeat. He would need to start and play about 28 minutes to matter.
Experts rank him around or outside the top 200 and give him almost no draft value. Josh does not understand his Yahoo ADP of 109.
Dallas has a 4-4-4 schedule in the fantasy playoffs, one of the best. It also has the league-high 16 back-to-backs.

durable.text: His category line is close to average in most categories, with above-average rebounds.
He is a weak free throw shooter for a shooter, in the 60s for three straight seasons. He is only a middling three-point shooter. His free throw volume is low, so the damage to FT% is limited.
Lloyd sees him as a backup-quality big man.

note: Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD (ranks 176 and 171), and the experts put him near or outside the top 200. He should not be drafted in our 144-player auction, even at the 3 USD he cost last season. Leave him on waivers. Early in the season, check whether his knee is cleared and whether injuries in the Dallas frontcourt give him 25 to 28 minutes. His line is about average across the board with a weak FT%, so his value depends almost fully on playing time.
